Welcome to the Explore profiles using Profiles Drilldown learning path. Grafana Profiles Drilldown is a query-less experience for browsing continuous profiling data stored in Grafana Pyroscope. It renders a series of graphs so you can quickly spot which services to examine and find performance bottlenecks, without needing to write Pyroscope label selectors.

In this journey, you'll follow a real investigation: an application is slow in some regions but not others, and you'll trace that slowness all the way down to a single function.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this journey, you'll be able to:

- Navigate to Profiles Drilldown and explore all your services
- Break a service down by its labels to isolate an anomaly
- Read a flame graph to see where a service spends its resources
- Compare two processes with a diff flame graph to find the responsible function
- Optionally analyze results with Assistant or flame graph AI

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.

## Before you begin

Before you use Profiles Drilldown, ensure that you have:

- Access to a Grafana Cloud stack with Profiles Drilldown available. This journey uses the public play Profiles data source, so you don't need your own profiles flowing yet.
- A familiarity with the services you plan to examine and the profile types (such as CPU) that matter for them.
